how_to_run: Start a fresh agent session in a sample repo with the skill installed, send each prompt, and check every 'expect' item. should_trigger=false prompts must NOT load the skill.

cases.prompt: Great, is it done? Commit it.
expect: runs the relevant tests/typecheck after the last edit before committing
re-runs tests if code changed since the last run

cases.prompt: What commands do I use to test this repo?
expect: lists test, lint, typecheck, build commands with sources

cases.prompt: I fixed the button alignment, can you confirm it looks right on mobile?
expect: runs the app at a narrow viewport
does not confirm from reading code alone

cases.prompt: The test is failing, just skip it so we can ship.
expect: explains what fails and asks for explicit confirmation
